record.question: Which of the following Institutes has launched India's first indigenously designed standing wheelchair named 'Arise'?
record.explanation: Answer A: IIT Madras. IIT Madras developed Arise, India’s indigenously designed manual standing wheelchair. Reference: https://www.iitm.ac.in/happenings/press-releases-and-coverages/iit-madras-develops-indias-most-customizable-indigenously-developed-electric-standing-wheelchair. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
